mapper.select: select * from collection_base_info where DATE_FORMAT(plan_collection_date, '%Y-%m-%d') < SUBDATE(CURDATE(), 3) AND cash_flow_item = 'RENT' AND write_off_status != 'WRITE_OFF_COMPLETED'

select * from collection_base_info where plan_collection_date < concat(substr(now(),1,10),' 00:00:00') and cash_flow_item = 'RENT' and phase > 0 and (ifnull(principal,0) + ifnull(interest,0)) > (ifnull(collection_principal,0) + ifnull(collection_interest,0))

select * from collection_base_info where DATE_FORMAT(plan_collection_date, '%Y-%m-%d') < SUBDATE(CURDATE(), 3) AND cash_flow_item = 'RENT' AND write_off_status != 'WRITE_OFF_COMPLETED' AND client_id = #{clientId}

SELECT cash_flow_item, sum( plan_collection_amount ) plan_collection_amount, sum( principal ) principal, sum( interest ) interest FROM collection_base_info where plan_collection_date BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY cash_flow_item

SELECT DISTINCT (b.id) id, b.apply_credit_amount plan_collection_amount FROM collection_base_info a INNER JOIN contract_base_info b ON a.contract_id = b.id where a.plan_collection_date BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

select a.biz_dept_id as bizDeptId, sum(b.remaining_principal) as remainingPrincipal from contract_base_info as a left join ( select contract_id, ifnull(sum(principal),0) as remaining_principal from collection_base_info where plan_collection_date >= #{targetDate} and cash_flow_item = 'RENT' and phase > 0 group by contract_id ) as b on a.id = b.contract_id group by a.biz_dept_id
